attendance.note: NZ Herald (31 Jul 2025): capacity for the 2025/26 JNGL edition cut to about 6,000, roughly half of previous years; 2024/25 attendance 'didn't quite hit the mark'. Organiser press release says that edition sold out in early December with 3,500+ people missing out. Press capacity figure, not a gate count.

ticket_price.note: 2025/26 first-release prices per NZ Herald: one-day pass $170, two-day pass $220. Camping, Fuzen Lounge VIP and bus passes extra. 2026/27 prices sold in rising tiers, not captured.

notes: Run by Fuzen Entertainment. After a weak 2024/25 and an earlier cancelled year, 2025/26 shrank to about 6,000 capacity (sold out); the 15th anniversary 2026/27 returns to a bigger format. @reloadnz on many posts is their social media agency, not a sponsor. Strictly R18, drum and bass crowd.
